description: Publish a key/value entry to BrewPage. Creates a KV store; the entry is addressed by (namespace, id, key). Returns a public URL and owner token.

key.description: KV key (first part of the (namespace, id, key) addressing tuple)

namespace.description: Optional. Omit to keep the content PRIVATE/unlisted (reachable only by its link — not listed in the gallery and not indexed by search engines). Pass a custom namespace to group private content, or pass `public` ONLY when the user explicitly wants the page listed in the brewpage.app gallery and indexed by search engines.

ownerToken.description: Existing owner token to group this KV store under the same owner as previous content

password.description: Optional password to protect the KV store

tags.description: Optional tags for the KV entry

ttlDays.description: Time to live in days (1-30, default: 15)

name: publish_kv
